title: Employee Sub Group Absence Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Absence types listed against an employee sub group. Not read at present: entitlements come from the sub group's leave rules, and nothing reads this list.

fields.html:
What it is. An absence type listed for the sub group.

Example. Hajj Leave

Why it matters. Each type can be listed once per sub group.
